jobs_results.description:
Description/Responsibilities
Our Marketing Analytics Director is a hands-on senior individual contributor responsible for building the reporting structure, performance measurement approach, and insight engine that helps Marketing make smarter, more informed decisions. This role leads analytics across Tivity Health’s Medicare and Commercial businesses, translating B2C, B2B2C, and B2B marketing performance into clear insights, executive-ready reporting, and actionable recommendations that drive optimization, action, and measurable business outcomes.


 


Working closely with cross-functional leaders across the business, this role will define key marketing metrics, develop dashboards and scorecards, evaluate campaign and channel performance, and connect marketing activity to member engagement, retention, subscriber growth, revenue contribution, and marketing efficiency. The Director will also help advance the use of automation, AI-enabled analytics, and emerging tools to improve reporting, pattern recognition, and proactive optimization.


 


Key Responsibilities:



 Drive performance delivery by using analytics to identify gaps, diagnose root causes, and recommend actions that improve campaign effectiveness, channel productivity, audience targeting, member engagement, retention, revenue contribution, and marketing ROI.
 Own the marketing analytics structure, reporting framework, and recurring insight cadence needed to give Marketing and senior leaders timely visibility into performance and clear recommendations for action.
 Lead advanced marketing analytics capabilities, including data modeling, attribution, segmentation, experimentation/A-B testing, CRM analytics, and marketing automation analytics to improve targeting, measurement, and performance optimization.
 Define, monitor, and communicate key performance indicators across channel performance, member engagement, participation, acquisition, conversion, retention, churn, revenue contribution, and marketing efficiency.
 Develop, deploy, and manage executive-ready dashboards, scorecards, and recurring performance reports across B2C, B2B2C, and B2B marketing activities.
 Measure and interpret engagement-driven metrics, including engagement rates, engagement lift, participation, churn, retention, channel effectiveness, campaign outcomes, and customer journey performance.
 Analyze campaign, channel, audience, and customer journey performance to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and optimization priorities.
 Establish a test-and-learn discipline that uses data, experimentation, and performance measurement to continuously optimize marketing campaigns, customer journeys, channel mix, and budget allocation.
 Translate complex marketing performance data into clear insights, performance stories, and actionable recommendations that support strategic and operational decision-making.
 Recommend opportunities to optimize media investment, channel mix, campaign targeting, customer journeys, retention strategies, and overall marketing effectiveness.
 Provide reporting and analytics to support member marketing, partner marketing, client performance tracking, lead generation, and business development efforts.
 Partner with Finance, Business Analytics, and business leaders to align marketing performance reporting with financial outcomes, growth priorities, and enterprise goals.
 Establish consistent definitions, measurement approaches, and data governance practices across marketing performance reporting.
 Work cross-functionally with internal teams and external partners to improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and insight generation related to Marketing.
 Identify opportunities to apply automation, AI-enabled analytics, machine learning, and emerging tools to enhance reporting, modeling, real-time performance tracking, and proactive recommendations.
 Support annual planning, forecasting, budget tracking, and ad hoc analysis for the CMO and other senior leaders.
 Inform optimization of the enterprise marketing technology suite by identifying reporting, data, measurement, and insight needs.

Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Analytics, Business, Finance, Statistics, or a related field preferred. Advanced degree a plus.
 8-10+ years of experience in marketing analytics, business intelligence, performance reporting, or related analytical roles.
 Demonstrated ability to use data and analytics to improve marketing performance, including identifying opportunities, influencing action, and measuring business impact.
 Strong understanding of B2C, B2B2C, and B2B marketing metrics, including engagement, acquisition, conversion, retention, churn, revenue contribution, and return on ad spend.
 Experience with subscription, membership, healthcare, Medicare, or regulated business models strongly preferred.
 Strong financial acumen, with the ability to connect marketing activity to growth, revenue, profitability, and efficiency outcomes.
 Advanced experience with reporting, dashboarding, visualization, and analytical tools; experience with Google Analytics, Tableau, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Snowflake, and Excel preferred.
 Ability to synthesize large datasets into concise, executive-level insights and recommendations.
 Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders without direct authority.
 Comfort operating as a hands-on individual contributor in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

What Success Looks Like


Success in this role means Marketing and senior leaders have trusted, timely, and decision-oriented analytics that make performance easier to understand and act on. This leader will bring structure to reporting, clarity to performance measurement, and practical recommendations that improve member engagement, subscriber growth, revenue contribution, retention, and marketing efficiency. They will also strengthen the connection between Marketing, Business Operations and Growth teams, and Finance so marketing performance becomes a clearer part of the enterprise’s broader understanding of growth and outcomes.


 


The salary range for this opportunity is $114,800 to $160,000. Compensation depends on several factors: qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience.


 


Tivity Health offers a robust benefits package, which includes a competitive salary, company bonus potential, medical, dental, vision, 401k with match, generous paid time off, free gym membership to over 13,000 fitness locations in the US, and other great benefits.

About ZBiotics




At ZBiotics, we make genetically engineered probiotics that improve daily life. As a group of motivated, yet down-to-earth people, we are fueled by two things: a love for science and a commitment to being people-first. GMO products like ours – built to create benefits for people in their daily lives – are the future. As the first to market, we believe it’s our duty to set a high bar for product quality, safety, and transparency for others to follow.




In 2019, ZBiotics launched Pre-Alcohol™ – the world's first genetically engineered probiotic drink – designed to break down acetaldehyde, an unwanted alcohol byproduct. In 2024, we launched Sugar-to-Fiber™ – a genetically engineered probiotic drink mix – that creates fiber from the sugar you already eat, contributing to microbiome health.




With a full line of genetically engineered probiotics in development, our team is growing. We’re looking for people as excited as we are to build this new category of consumer products. ZBiotics is headquartered in San Francisco and backed by venture investors including Y Combinator and Khosla Ventures, among others.




With two category-defining products—Pre-Alcohol and Sugar-to-Fiber—we're scaling rapidly across DTC and Amazon, expanding our retail footprint, and beginning to explore international markets. As we scale, we need sharper, faster, and more reliable data to drive every growth decision we make.




We're looking for a Marketing Analytics Lead who is equally at home writing a SQL query and designing a survey, who can build a dashboard and explain what it means to a non-technical stakeholder, and who brings enough statistical rigor that A/B testing is second nature. This person will be embedded in the Marketing team—working directly with the CMO, VP of Growth, and Brand Director—while partnering closely with our central Data & Analytics team on infrastructure and standards.




Your Impact

As Marketing Analytics Lead, you are the analytical engine behind ZBiotics' growth marketing function. You ensure that the team's performance data is accurate, accessible, and actionable—and that our decisions are grounded in rigorous analysis, not instinct alone.

You own the data infrastructure that powers marketing reporting, the measurement frameworks that connect spend to outcomes, and the analytical partnership that keeps Marketing leadership operating with a clear view of where we are and where we're headed.




This is not a reporting-only role. You'll shape how we think about attribution, incrementality, and brand impact—areas where the right frameworks matter as much as the right data.




You will report to the Chief Marketing Officer, with a dotted line to the VP of Growth Marketing, who will be a primary internal client. You will also partner regularly with the Brand team on awareness campaigns and qualitative insights work, and with our central Data & Analytics team, keeping them informed on marketing data infrastructure decisions and aligned on shared standards.
